title: Vonage API Developer
snippet:
[##### Vonage Messages API
Reach your customers on the channels they already use — SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, Viber, and Email — all from a single API endpoint.
- Send text, images, audio, video, and files across multiple channels without managing separate integrations.
- Build two-way conversational experiences with WhatsApp templates, interactive messaging, and inbound webhooks.
- Start fast with SMS and then layer in richer channels as your product and audience grow.](https://www.vonage.com/communications-apis/messages/)
## Partner with Vonage
If you're an incubator, accelerator, angel investor, venture capital firm, or other startup — then join us. Our combined portfolio and ecosystem are great ways to enhance the startup community.
Vonage for Startups helps burgeoning brands with tailored support and up to $75,000 Vonage API credits.

For consideration, applicants must meet the following criteria:
- Early-stage (Pre-Seed - Series A)
- Founded in the past 5 years
- Have a company website and associated emails
- Have a Vonage API account
- Not be an existing managed customer

title: Vonage Network Registry | Vonage API Documentation
snippet:
To use the [Vonage Network Features](/en/getting-started-network/concepts/network-features) in production, you will need to register for approval to access Operator networks from one or more applications.
To streamline this process for you, Vonage manages registration with numerous operator partners behind the scenes for all supported Network Features, in any [country made available by Vonage](/en/getting-started-network/concepts/coverage). This process is dependent on each Operator’s approval, which may come through to the Vonage Network Registry at different times.

Once your registration is approved by at least one Operator, you can link it to one or more Vonage Applications to start using Network Features. The Vonage application contains the credentials needed to make API calls.

title: Getting Started with Vonage's WhatsApp Business API: New V4 Embedded Sign-Up flow
snippet:
This flow is for **direct customers only** — businesses that will be using WhatsApp for their own business use.
If you are creating a WhatsApp Account on behalf of another business (for example, as a Partner or Billing Agent), this flow does not apply to you. You must first become a **Vonage partner** by reaching out [**here**](https://www.vonage.com/contact-us/).

## Prerequisites for using Embedded Sign-Up
- You must have access to your business **Vonage Communications API Account** via the [Vonage Dashboard](https://www.vonage.co.uk/log-in/)
- You must have an active **personal Facebook Account**
- You must have access to your **business's Facebook Business Manager Account**. If you don't have one, you can create one via **Embedded Sign Up** (see below).
- You'll need the **phone number** you want to use for WhatsApp. This can be either a **Vonage LVN** or your own number. In either case, the phone number must meet the following **requirements**:
- Must accept VOICE calls or SMS (for Contact Centre numbers, the IVR system must be able to be disabled or intercepted to complete the 2FA)
- Not a short code or toll-free number
- Business phone numbers can only be registered for use with the Cloud API

### You will see an introductory screen — **"Seamlessly connect your account to Vonage Communication APIs & Conversational Commerce Platform"** — which explains that this onboarding process will register and connect your business account to Vonage as your partner.
Review and agree to the Meta terms shown on screen before continuing.
Vonage acts as your [WhatsApp Business Solution Provider (BSP)](https://faq.whatsapp.com/695500918177858?helpref=faq_content) and will manage your integration through its own dedicated **Messaging Account (PMA)** — keeping your billing and templates isolated from any other BSP you may use.

## Vonage Verified Implementation Partners
The Vonage Verified Implementation Partner Program (VVIP) gives qualified partners the ability to directly implement both Vonage Business Communications and Vonage Contact Center. VVIP also allows partners to have customer-approved administrative access to their customer accounts using their own native partner credentials.
Interested? Fill out the form and your Regional Channel Manager will contact you with more information.

title: Vonage API Developer
snippet:
**Who is eligible to apply for the program?**
We are technology agnostic and want to support as many startups as possible. For consideration, applicants must meet the following criteria:
- Early-stage (Pre-Seed - Series A)
- Founded in the past 5 years
- Have a company website and associated emails
- Have a Vonage API account
- Not be an existing managed customer

As part of the onboarding process, we will identify the best mix of resources to meet your needs. This includes technical workshops, 1:1s with Vonage product managers, and any other support — such as up to $75,000 in Vonage API credits.
